entities.name: Fast Fashion
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Zara, H&M, and Primark pioneered rapid-cycle fashion — from runway to store in 2 weeks instead of 6 months. Clothing became disposable; the average garment is worn 7 times before being discarded. 100 billion garments are produced annually.
